problem.statement: Small Shopify sellers struggle to track inventory costs without expensive tooling.
problem.current_alternative: Sellers currently track inventory costs manually in spreadsheets.
problem.desired_outcome: Sellers can see real-time cost and margin data without manual entry.

target_audience.segment: Small independent Shopify store owners with 1-3 staff.
target_audience.context: Managing inventory alongside marketing, fulfillment, and customer support with no dedicated ops role.

assumptions.claim: A meaningful segment of the target audience is budget-conscious and price sensitive.
The current manual process is time-consuming enough that users would switch tools.

evidence.claim: 68% of surveyed respondents ranked price as their top decision factor.
Support tickets show recurring complaints about the manual process taking over an hour per week.

alternatives.name: Generic spreadsheet templates
alternatives.difference: Requires manual upkeep and offers no automation or validation.

alternatives.name: Competitor X subscription tool
alternatives.difference: Covers similar ground but is priced significantly higher and lacks Shopify-specific workflows.
